2: By David, in his changing his behaviour before Abimelech, and he driveth him away, and he goeth. I do bless Jehovah at all times, Continually His praise is in my mouth.
3: In Jehovah doth my soul boast herself, Hear do the humble and rejoice.
4: Ascribe ye greatness to Jehovah with me, And we exalt His name together.
5: I sought Jehovah, and He answered me, And from all my fears did deliver me.
6: They looked expectingly unto Him, And they became bright, And their faces are not ashamed.
7: This poor one called, and Jehovah heard, And from all his distresses saved him.
8: A messenger of Jehovah is encamping, Round about those who fear Him, And He armeth them.
9: Taste ye and see that Jehovah is good, O the happiness of the man who trusteth in Him.
10: Fear Jehovah, ye His holy ones, For there is no lack to those fearing Him.
11: Young lions have lacked and been hungry, And those seeking Jehovah lack not any good,
12: Come ye, children, hearken to me, The fear of Jehovah I do teach you.
13: Who is the man that is desiring life? Loving days to see good?
14: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking deceit.
15: Turn aside from evil and do good, Seek peace and pursue it.
16: The eyes of Jehovah are unto the righteous, And His ears unto their cry.
17: (The face of Jehovah is on doers of evil, To cut off from earth their memorial.)
18: They cried, and Jehovah heard, And from all their distresses delivered them.
19: Near is Jehovah to the broken of heart, And the bruised of spirit He saveth.
20: Many are the evils of the righteous, Out of them all doth Jehovah deliver him.
21: He is keeping all his bones, One of them hath not been broken.
22: Evil doth put to death the wicked, And those hating the righteous are desolate.
23: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of His servants, And none trusting in Him are desolate!
